The skill bundle is benign. It defines a 'find-products' skill that instructs the AI agent to make a GET request to `https://trend-hunt.com/api/search` using `curl` to retrieve product information based on user queries. The `SKILL.md` file clearly outlines the API usage, parameters, and expected response format.
